title: Count the Inversions
prompt:
**Bài toán.** An array of n integers (up to 10^9): print the number of
pairs i < j with a[i] > a[j]. Use 64-bit for the answer.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200 000. Coordinate compression + BIT: O(n log n).

tests.name: small
duplicates are not inversions
n=200000 decreasing
tests.hint: Strictly decreasing: n(n-1)/2 = 19999900000. O(n^2) enumeration cannot finish.
